results.title: UEC Gears Up to Report Q4 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
results.author: Na
results.description: Uranium Energy (UEC) is expected to report $9 million in Q4 revenues versus nil a year ago, but still post a loss of four cents per share. While uranium prices rose 16% year-over-year, higher operating, exploration, and development costs are expected to offset revenue gains. The company's shares have declined 18.1% over the past year.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Expected to report a loss despite revenue growth; higher operating and exploration costs offset increased revenues; stock has underperformed the industry with an 18.1% decline over the past year; Earnings ESP of 0% indicates no predictive advantage for an earnings beat.
Total revenues declined 7% in Q2 2026; uranium sales volumes fell 18%; adjusted earnings fell 75% year-over-year due to lower uranium sales volumes and decline in equity earnings from Westinghouse.

Q2 revenues surged 496% to $25 million, showing strong growth; however, posted a wider loss of 13 cents per share compared to 10 cents in the year-ago quarter, indicating profitability challenges despite revenue expansion.

Q2 revenues increased to $14.37 million from $10.44 million year-over-year; uranium sales volume increased from 165,000 to 215,000 pounds; quarterly loss of four cents per share was in line with the year-ago quarter, showing stable performance.
